resources.string: Beeswax isn\'t activated yet. To set it up, follow the setup guide on the website or GitHub.
Pick the apps you want to block. Browsers and any app you install after locking are blocked by default.
Beeswax is locked. Enter your lock code to change which apps are blocked.
Test build: debugging stays on while locked.
You need it to change which apps are blocked or to deactivate Beeswax. If you lose it, the only way back is a factory reset.
Your new code applies only to this user profile. Other user profiles keep their own codes.
Your new code replaces your current code once you\'ve confirmed it on the next page.
That doesn\'t match. Here\'s the code again.
Beeswax can\'t lock while this phone has other users. Delete them in Settings → System → Users, then try again.
Couldn\'t turn system backups back on.
Locks the private DNS you set in Settings → Network & internet → Private DNS so it can\'t be changed without your lock code to Beeswax.
Set a private DNS provider in Settings first, then turn this on.
The new user is locked with your current lock code. Switch to it and add apps to it in Settings → System → Users.
Leave all three empty to turn it off.
If you lose your lock code, you can unlock without it after the waiting period.
After %1$s, you can unlock Beeswax without your lock code. You can cancel the wait at any time, and typing your lock code cancels it too.
The recovery wait is over. Unlock works without your lock code. Save a new code to lock Beeswax again.
Blocked apps here are blocked between these times on the days you pick. A block that runs past midnight belongs to the day it starts.
To stop clock changes getting around the schedule, turn on Lock date and time on this page in the Owner profile.
